description: Actual shared Solo/Duo combat, 50 ms steps, neutral terrain, no augments. Moving 880-unit road, 24 enemies or one boss. Tier 1: 250 gold/W10; tier 4: 1000 gold/W18. Support armies spend up to 42% on control, remainder on archers. Other armies fill discrete leftover gold with archers. Gamble uses eight seeds. Stationary values are a separate 20-second role check, not balance proof.
